name: Summer Wild Adventure Programs
description_short: Week-long half-day and full-day zoo programs for grades K-11, run by EARTH ltd with Southwick's Zoo. Licensed educators lead each week, which covers one animal theme through animal encounters, building enrichment for zoo animals, behind-the-scenes care, games and art.

warnings: The page lists the 2026 summer season, which has already ended (today is 2026-10-13). The 2027 dates, prices and sessions have not been posted yet.
The page is out of date in places: the FAQ still mentions the '2025 drop off/pick up location', and the footer says © 2024.
Session prices are non-member rates and include Eventbrite fees. EARTH ltd members get about 10% off, and the child must be a current member when registering.

The address recorded is the EARTH Nature Center in Millville, MA, which is the organization's address. Programs take place at Southwick's Zoo. The page says the drop-off/pick-up location 'will be updated in early June.'
Each session has its own Eventbrite registration link, so there is no single registration URL.
price_per_week is left blank because weekly prices vary a lot: half-day, 9am-2pm and full-day weeks all cost different amounts. One T-Rex to Turkeys session runs only 3 days (June 29 - July 1).
The Wild Adventure Program is separate from Junior Zookeeping, which is run by different staff.
